about.text: The milk spirit of the Khakas of southern Siberia, distilled from airan, soured milk, and formerly also from kumis.

facts.v: Large cauldron on a tripod, wooden domed lid with two bent wooden pipes (sorga) leading into two cast-iron jugs standing in a trough of cold water
Cauldron set in the stove, bottomless conical tub on top with a sloping spout-trough inside, cold-water pot (takhtai) as lid
East-Mongolian (Khalkha) type, borrowed by the Khakas from Tuva in the 19th century
